inputs.text: [excited] MOH… sah… SOR… us. [curious] Two pieces in this name. [pauses] "Mosa" is the Meuse, a river in Europe, where his first bones were found.
[warmly] The whole name, yes — except he didn't live in a river: [amazed] he swam in EVERY ocean in the world, seventy million years ago, [pauses] at the same time as Tritri, on land.
